question: Should OpenClaw add a persisted spawned-session rootSessionKey and traceId contract now, and should traceId be a new session-chain identifier or intentionally tied to existing diagnostic tracing?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but naming and trace semantics become a public Gateway/session API contract and should not be chosen by repair automation.

options.title: Approve narrow chain metadata
options.body: Add optional rootSessionKey and traceId as a bounded session-chain contract with native/ACP spawn derivation and list projections, while deferring traversal and UI graph APIs.

options.title: Use existing lineage only
options.body: Keep spawnedBy, parentSessionKey, spawnDepth, childSessions, ACP metadata, and resolver lineage as the supported surfaces, and close or narrow this request accordingly.

options.title: Defer for a broader lineage design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers align spawned-session chains, resolver-family lineage, recursive listing, and lifecycle cleanup under one explicit design.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow chain metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional rootSessionKey and traceId as a bounded session-chain contract with native/ACP spawn derivation and list projections, while deferring traversal and UI graph APIs.
